review: This is reliably the only Cheesesteak my husband can get that satisfies his craving. I don't eat meat so I was skeptical that I'd be able to get anything from a place with meat in the name, but the Little Grilled Cheese was delicious and fresh! The fries are a sizeable portion and are tasty too. I'd recommend the regular and the old bay fries. Will definitely order again.

I had just read that this was one of the best burgers in Atlanta. They weren't lying! Excellent classic burger and the fries with ranch were delicious.I could only eat half of the burger and a few of the huge order of fries so I have dinner tomorrow, too!
Fred's makes some of the best Burgers I've ever had in this city. Two juicy patties are so filling and fresh every time I get it delivered. One of my faves to grab for lunch.
The fries were seasoned nicely. The aoili was a nice touch for the fries. The burger was simple, classic & yummy. This is really two meals. I ate  half tonight, I'll eat half tomorrow. I'm satisfied!
It was a good cheesesteak, but it was so small. I get double the size ones up North for the same price

Fred's is one of our favorites. The Korean Cheesesteak is delicious and unique. The Burger Stack is juicy with cheesy deliciousness. And the BBQ Fries & White BBQ Sauce and Regular Hand Cut Fries are plentiful and thick cut. Love pairing it with the garlic aioli. You really can't go wrong with anything here. So good!

Always delicious. Their cheeseburger is the ONLY burger I'll eat with pickles. Idk why, it just taste different/better on a Fred's sandwich! Old bay Old Bay Fries & Tartar Sauce were also delish. Can't eat all in one sitting but toss them in the air fryer the next day and they're amazing all over again. 10/10!

This is my go to restaurant for door dash. I've bragged to everyone I know about the food here especially the burgers! His Burger Stack are the best burgers I've ever tasted! I love the Old Bay Fries & Tartar Sauce fries also. The food is absolutely amazing!!

The People said this is one of the best burgers in Atlanta, and I have to agree. The Burger Stack has such a great amount of flavor and cooked to still be juicy. You also get a bunch of fries when your order Regular Hand Cut Fries too. At first the price seemed a little high, but once the 20% kicked in, that price seemed more reasonable. Would definitely order this again!

I took a chance at trying this place bc I'm new to the area. The Korean Cheesesteak was THE best sandwich I've ever had IN MY LIFE!it was so flavorful. I didn't take a picture of it because it was gone before I knew it. I also loved the cut of their Regular Hand Cut Fries mixed with the garlic aioli (on the side). I'm a fan of big fries and these did not disappoint. I ordered from door dash so the items were pricey but my order customization was followed perfectly and well worth every dollar! This place has gained a new fan! Not just a customer but a fan! Can't wait to try other stuff on the menu!

Chicken was cooked perfectly. Plenty of pasta and sauce. No skimping. Probably one of the best orders I’ve had in awhile. Plus, everything arrived. The Bellagio was new to me, and I’ll be getting it again for sure!

Portion sizes have been cut in half & prices have gone up.  The Hot Spinach and Cheese Dip is really good, but $17 for 1/2 of what it used to be (chips portion also way smaller) is really disappointing.  Cobb Salad, smaller container as well.  Barely any chicken on it.  Everything tastes really good though

I spent $8 to add steak to my pasta and I only received a 4 small bites and the meat was tough and dry. Also, the pasta was $24 and it only covered the bottom of the container, so it wasn't full to the top to be worth the $24.

The cookie dough Cookie Dough Lover’s Cheesecake with Pecans slice that I received was very small and mostly cooked, hard, dry, cookie dough with little cheesecake. If the dessert was better I might have been more disappointed  to see that most of the container was whip cream.
The The Cheesecake Factory Special Lemonade was delicious, wish they had larger to go cups.

Just for reference this is what a full (Full Portion) Thai Lettuce Wraps with extra chicken and sauces looks like. I do feel that for almost $9 extra I could've gotten more chicken but it is what it is.

The Chicken Piccata pasta didn't have ANY sauce - it used to come with a side cup of sauce.
The Grilled Branzino portion was small as were the green beans.
No butter with the bread. 
Very disappointed with the consistency.

You have to add utensils to your order.
Food was very good. I love the Fettuccini Alfredo with Chicken ! & the Classic Basque Cheesecake was delicious- strawberries and blueberries were in a container on the side, so the cheesecake was not soggy. 

-I added the first part due to the reviews.

Highly disappointed with these entrees.  The Beet and Avocado Salad was skimpy definitely not $13.50 worth of salad more like $5.  The Bang Bang Shrimp was simply not good couldn't even finish the dish. Entrees used to be large and flavorful with plenty of leftovers. These sizes were definitely 1/2 to 1/3  smaller than what I remember and more expensive at that.

The dips has not been tasted yet,  but the kids portion Kids' Spaghetti with Meatball is huge. The temperature is decent The Kids' Roadside Sliders are good
Unsatisfied with Tropical Ginger Cooler because it was not sealed . I will not drink it due to poor packaging.

Terrible Pasta. Dry Bow Tie. No sauce at all to the point where I had to make my own. You could see the clear pasta covered with no sauce. I paid 8 dollars for 3 shrimp. Spaghetti pieces scattered throughout the dish. Sloppy "cooks". I was so desperate I remade it with whatever the heck I could put together. Lol Make your own pasta guys.... it will be more decadent.
